summary: Practise active listening, SBI feedback and GROW coaching for employee conversations. Explore the five-day HR course and its practical curriculum.
lede: Interpersonal dynamics in HR reflect how communication, emotions and working relationships shape employee conversations. For HR practitioners and people managers, this course develops practical ways to handle employee concerns, feedback and coaching through active listening, SBI feedback, GROW coaching, conflict responses, confidentiality boundaries and clear follow-up plans.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who handle employee concerns, feedback and coaching conversations as part of HR or people-management work.
prerequisites: Level: Foundation / beginner. Familiarity with routine workplace or HR conversations is useful. No coding or specialist software is required.
